arms: lab v3, Opus in every role (director and workers), replicate 1: run dir runs/dev-panel-noise-sc-lab1, --max-usd 11
lab v3, Opus in every role (director and workers), replicate 2: run dir runs/dev-panel-noise-sc-lab2, --max-usd 11
Opus alone, 4 single attempts per task: run dir runs/dev-panel-noise-sc-opus-single, --max-usd 3
primary_endpoint: The per-task flip rate between the two lab replicates (final answer passed or failed), and the noise threshold T: the 95th percentile of |rescued - damaged| between replicates from a bootstrap over the panel's tasks, and at least 2.
stop_rules: If more than 25% of the panel's tasks flip between the two lab replicates, grow the panel or score moves only in reuse mode (Config.reuse_first_round).
notes: The scBench part of the Phase 1 noise panel: the three scBench dev tasks sc01, sc07, sc08 (every scBench task has been seen; these were dev from the start). The BioDSA part is dev-panel-noise. Caps per run folder: 11 + 11 + 3 = 25 dollars, set from the measured cost of committed runs (about $3 per lab study, $0.13 per single attempt). Lab runs use --memory past, --backend modal, --parallel 8, --snapshot-first-round, with the v3 switches (no --recheck, no --guard).
